name: Google Business Profile
body:
> Tool · 2026-10-01

# Summary
Google Business Profile (GBP) drives map pack visibility and a large share of leads for TAG clients. For Claude it is mostly **read-only**: recommendations go to Kim or Scott.

# Rules by client
- **Pipeliners:** GBP is read-only. No posts, services or link edits; report only. The GBP phone (480-447-5345) differs from the site source number (480-535-6503) by design, for call tracking.
- **Summit AZ:** GBP (location 93167) is hands off; read metrics only. Do not re-ask Scott about hours.
- **Alphalete:** Scott handles the GBP.
- **Images (Scott):** internal pipe damage or lining work only, never under-sink plumbing.

# Routines
- Kim's day starts with GBP photo posts for Summit and Pipeliners (posted manually).
- GBP monthly content batches live in `_Shared (All Clients)\GBP Content\` (the August v2 batch had 16 posts not yet posted).
- Map rankings come from [Search Atlas](lib:brain-search-atlas) local grids and feed the [Client Report Dashboard](lib:brain-client-report-dashboard).
- In GA4, Alphalete's GBP website link is UTM-tagged as google / organic, so GBP visits count as Organic Search.

# Learning references
GBP setup, posts, reviews and policy pitfalls are covered in [Local SEO Lesson](lib:brain-local-seo-lesson) (Modules 2, 9, 10) and [AI SEO Masterclass - Module 5 Local SEO in the AI Era](lib:brain-ai-seo-masterclass-module-5-local-seo-in-the-ai-era).
